title: CarbiCrete cement-free concrete masonry unit
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The product is a cement-free CMU made from steel slag, aggregate, water, admixtures and carbon dioxide; listed units are 190 × 390 × 190 mm.

The NBC 2015 opinion classifies masonry unit standards, unit masonry construction and a detailed ASTC calculation method as Alternative; fire-separation provisions are listed separately as Acceptable.
facts.locator: CCMC 14346-R PDF, p. 2, Compliance opinion table

facts.text: A table of product-specific masonry assembly properties includes a reported 1.5-hour fire-resistance rating for wall assemblies constructed with the product.
facts.locator: CCMC 14346-R PDF, p. 8, Non-structural performance of walls table

limitations: The reported fire rating is tied to described wall assemblies; it is not a universal block rating.
The report is not project-specific engineering or an approval decision.
